title: نجوا
notes: Cassette with Persian calligraphy artwork titled 'Najva'. Credits include Shahram Nazeri (vocals), Mohammad Reza Lotfi (arrangement and conducting), Habibollah Badiei (tar), Gholamhossein Bigcheh Khani (ney), Mojtaba Mirzadeh (ney, kamancheh), Ali Naseri (tar), and the Shida Ensemble. Poetry attributed to Rumi, Hafez, and Saadi. Likely a private or unofficial duplication; no catalog number or barcode present.
